objective: Fix the Crossref live qualification probe to use the documented versioned REST endpoint after Cohort 1 returned HTTP 404.

rulesConsidered: IMPLEMENTED and QUALIFIED remain separate lifecycle states.
The qualification harness may only record QUALIFIED from real provider evidence.
The fix must not expand provider authority into F00, Treasury, ComputeRouter, F06, CAS, F07, or Overseer.

notes: The fix only changes the Crossref REST path from /works to /v1/works.
The regression test uses a local fetch stub and does not contact Crossref.

changes: Changed the Crossref qualification probe from https://api.crossref.org/works to https://api.crossref.org/v1/works.
Updated the deterministic qualification test to require the versioned Crossref REST endpoint and a representative message.items response.
Kept #184 unchanged until a fresh live Crossref run produces evidence.

externalVerification.rationale: Crossref documents /v1/works as the versioned REST endpoint and recommends specifying the API version.

verificationPlan: Pass Team Change Gate, OKF Governance, API Provider Fabric Verification, and repository CI.
Merge PR #201 to main only after required validation succeeds.
Rerun Crossref live qualification from main.
Use only the new Crossref live evidence to update #184.
notes: The previous Crossref 404 is recorded as CONFIGURED-BUT-NOT-QUALIFIED, not QUALIFIED.
No provider disposition in #184 is changed by this fix PR.
